title: What If You Lived Underwater for a Whole Month? Someone Did

scenes.text: What if you lived underwater for a month? In 2014, a team did, sixty-three feet down.
Mission 31 ran from June first to July first, in the Aquarius habitat off Key Largo, Florida.
At that depth your body soaks up gas until it cannot take any more. Divers call that saturation.
Once saturated, you can dive up to nine hours a day without decompressing after each dive.
The price comes at the end. You decompress only once, but you cannot simply swim back up.
Fabien Cousteau's team beat the thirty days his grandfather's crew spent underwater in 1963 by exactly one day.

description:
What if you lived underwater for a whole month?
In 2014, Mission 31 spent 31 days in the Aquarius habitat, 63 feet below the surface.
What should we run through next?
first_comment: Could you handle a month at the bottom of the sea? Drop your own 'what if'.
